caption: A top-down view shows a shiny CD/DVD disc set into a black circular ring on a white surface, forming a clock-like face. Gold handwritten numerals already mark the ring, an upside-down "12" at the bottom and a "9" on the right. A left hand grips a brown squeeze bottle with a yellow label and a fine tip, pressing that tip against the ring at the lower-left position. A right hand's fingers rest on the upper-right edge, holding the assembly steady. The disc displays a bright vertical rainbow reflection band through its center. The left hand keeps the tip in contact with the ring, laying down a small gold stroke that grows from a tiny dot into a short mark. The hand and bottle drift only modestly while the tip stays on the same region. The right hand, the disc, and the existing numerals remain essentially stationary throughout. Slight camera jitter shifts the framing a little, but the composition and the writing motion persist.
relations: The left hand's bottle tip pressed on the lower-left ring deposits a gold stroke that grows from a dot.
The right hand's fingers on the upper-right edge hold the disc-ring assembly stationary while writing.
Existing numerals and the disc's rainbow reflection remain fixed as the new mark extends.
Slight camera jitter shifts framing without changing the tip's contact region or the writing motion.
